items.t: Front lower ball joint wear and separation
items.note: Price covers both sides. Recalls covered many 2002-2006 joints, so check your VIN. Alignment may be extra.

items.t: Front upper ball joint can separate (salt-belt recall)
items.job: Replace both front upper control arms
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected salt-belt vehicles. Check your VIN. The ball joint comes built into the arm.

items.t: Rear lower control arms crack from rust
items.job: Replace both rear lower control arms
items.note: Recalls covered many 2004-2007 vehicles. Check your VIN before paying. Rusted bolts can add time.

items.t: Airbags can go off without a crash
items.job: Replace airbag control module or add recall jumper harness
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank can leak in a rear crash
items.job: Inspect rear structure and install factory tow hitch
items.note: Free inspection and hitch work under recall 13V-252. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.
Price is per door. The regulator and motor are usually sold as one unit.

items.t: Dropped valve seat on the 3.7L V6
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured unit
items.note: A used engine sits at the low end; a new 3.7L crate engine is about $3,900 (Quadratec). Book time is about 10.7 hours for a complete engine and 14.7 hours for a long block (2CarPros). If caught early, a cylinder head repair may cost less.

items.t: Park may not hold (park pawl recall)
items.job: Inspect transmission and install park pawl retaining bracket
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.job: Update TIPM software or replace occupant restraint controller
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Steering column pivot rivet may be missing
items.job: Inspect steering column and repair pivot rivet
items.note: Free inspection and repair under recall 11V-315. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Brake line and booster pushrod recalls
items.job: Replace brake tubes and booster input rod clip
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Sky Slider canvas roof leaks and jams
items.job: Replace Sky Slider folding top frame (tracks and cables)
items.note: Mopar frame 68055315AF lists at $2,050 MSRP ($1,378 discounted, without motor); availability may be limited since the original supplier closed. One owner was told removing the top takes about 4 hours. Owner-reported totals run about $900-$3,200 (dealer quotes $2,800-$3,200); smaller fixes such as a canvas top or control module can cost less.
